correctness.rationale: For each of 720 permutations, the 56 Boolean queries (unlabeled subsets of sizes 2..5) produce exactly 360 distinct response masks, paired by reversal. Both sliding-window and position-span definitions match. Hereditary exact bitset splitting enumerates all supports and gives [1,56,1540,17640,54810,20160,0], facets4=25830, facets5=20160. Complete all-positive-order mod-2 elimination gives rank4=5040, rank5=15120, independent of chosen positive order, with orbit sizes 47 and 29. Separately reconstructed integer enumeration and orbit checks corroborated these exact finite outcomes, not sampling.
